tools.name: search_stacks
tools.description: Find agent stacks by problem domain or text. A query is split into words and any of them may match, against the name, the copy, and the prompt. When nothing matches, the reply is labelled and filled with the most established stacks.

tools.name: get_stack
tools.description: One stack's card: its copy, its tools, its tier, and its revision.

tools.name: get_manifest
tools.description: The manifest a loader runs: the tools, the model, the harness, and the prompt. This is the thing to install.

tools.name: get_install_plan
tools.description: How to install a stack: the MCP servers to configure, the shell commands to run, and the notes (a path, a harness command) for the rest. Deciding and configuring are open; the agent's host runs the commands.
